cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails; the rest key is named before they start; the hint says the pivot did move, Edit > Undo first, then the rest key's time

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Before the try, Turn 2 named the rest key and time ('Pop is at full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s'). Turn 3 says 'Pop's pivot did move', gives the 3.3 s the check read, and asks for 'Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3 s'. 'Far below' matches the tool's outside_side 'below'. It does not explicitly say nothing may have shown, but no fail condition is hit.
Turn 3 says what is off and where: Pop's pivot is far below Pop, and the playhead was at 3.3 s, not 4.3 s. It leaves the redo to the learner ('Say done when it's there') and never offers to fix it.
Every name, side and time the mentor uses appears in tool results: Door, its middle-left place, Pop, bottom-middle, 4.3 s (check_time), 3.3 s (check time) and 'below' (outside_side).
